items.t: Grand jury declines to indict Cassidy Hutchinson, who testified about Trump and Jan. 6, sources say
items.x: Justice Department prosecutors on Tuesday could not secure a grand jury indictment of former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson, who testified about President Trump's role in Jan. 6, sources say.

items.t: Alex Pretti’s family says feds are still stonewalling efforts for justice
items.x: The parents of Alex Pretti, an American man shot and killed by ICE agents in Minneapolis in January, are accusing the DOJ of violating their rights.

items.t: Gov. DeSantis names late John Anderson's 'Seminole Wind' as new Florida Anthem
items.x: Gov. Ron DeSantis issued an executive order on Tuesday designating “Seminole Wind” by country artist John Anderson as Florida's Anthem.

items.t: Truck stolen by escaped Tennessee inmate is found abandoned in Illinois, authorities say
items.x: Authorities say an escaped Tennessee inmate convicted of murdering a co-worker stole a truck from a nearby farm and apparently made it to southern Illinois before abandoning it.

items.t: Senior US official says Flavio Bolsonaro and family will be granted U.S. visas after election loss
items.x: A senior State Department official says Brazilian opposition candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family will be granted U.S. visas after his presidential election loss.

items.t: A dinosaur fossil that looks like a mini T. rex just sold to a mystery buyer for a giant $47 million
items.x: The rare skeleton of a Nanotyrannus, a distant cousin of Tyrannosaurus rex, sold for $47.3 million to a mystery buyer at auction in New York City on Tuesday.

items.t: 3 Alexander brothers each get 30 years in prison for sex trafficking after women talk of being raped
items.x: Three brothers convicted of exploiting their wealth and access to luxury real estate to drug and rape dozens of women have been sentenced to 30 years in prison

items.t: Man convicted of sexually abusing child for almost a decade at Lehigh Acres home
items.x: A man was convicted of familial or custodial sexual battery and lewd or lascivious molestation after a two-day jury trial in Lee County.

items.t: US and Cuban officials get in a shouting match during UN debate over economic embargo
items.x: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday.

items.t: Man gets life in prison after molesting child for more than a decade in Cape Coral
items.x: A man was adjudicated guilty and sentenced to life in prison for lewd and lascivious molestation in Lee County.

items.t: Toyota issues recall for more than 220,000 vehicles: See model affected
items.x: Toyota has issued a recall for more than 220,000 vehicles after it said there were issues with some back seats that may fail to remain secure in the event of a crash.

items.t: USPS recommends mailing ballots today in 34 states. Here's how to make sure yours counts
items.x: The Postal Service advises voters in 34 states to mail their ballots by today to ensure they arrive by Election Day, while experts suggest exploring other return options if mailing is no longer viable.

items.t: Ashley Moody looks to secure Florida Senate seat against opponent Angie Nixon in special election
items.x: Ashley Moody was appointed to Marco Rubio’s Senate seat in January. Now she faces Angie Nixon in a special election that will decide who serves the rest of the term.

items.t: No clear winner in Israeli election, exit polls suggest, as Netanyahu’s fate hangs in the balance
items.x: Israelis were voting Tuesday in a tense national election widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership since the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel and the wars that have since shaken the Middle East.

items.t: David Jolly targets Florida governor seat in showdown with Republican Byron Donalds
items.x: Democratic candidate David Jolly is targeting Florida’s governor seat in a showdown with Republican Byron Donalds in November.

items.t: School bus crash closed Fowler Street in Fort Myers Tuesday afternoon, no students injured
items.x: There were no injuries aboard a school bus involved in a crash with a vehicle on Fowler Street at Franklin Street in Fort Myers on Tuesday.

items.t: Hunter Biden laptop issue resurfaces as judge scolds prosecutors over case against ex-FBI officials
items.x: A federal judge has scolded the DOJ for its handling of a criminal case against two former FBI officials accused of making false statements to Congress about investigations involving Hunter Biden.

items.x: Winds will gust over 30 mph across the Gulf Coast Tuesday and Wednesday.
